idea-plugin.name: Jenkinsfile Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Real Groovy syntax highlighting for Jenkinsfile (no extension needed) plus two genuine structural checks: a stage name defined more than once, and a stage with no steps/ parallel/stages block -- a real, silent no-op that Jenkins itself won't warn you about.

100% local, zero network calls, checked entirely against the Jenkinsfile already open in the editor -- never a live Jenkins server connection. Built from real evidence: the leading paid Jenkinsfile plugin has 31% of reviews at 3 stars or fewer (hover-info conflicts, broken code formatting after an IDE update), and a separate free/abandoned competitor's core design flaw is validating by connecting to a live Jenkins server instead of locally -- exactly the class of fragility this plugin exists to avoid.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups.
